summary: Kerb beside the station with houses 1-4 m away and time-limited signs.

best_section.where: Railway Avenue, midway along, opposite the station car park

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 1 m (at 28 m) and 4 m (at 47 m), apartments 4 m (at 59 m) line the east side; no stretch is clear of dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Public lane with cars parked along the kerb; fits a van, little spare room.
drivers.traffic: Beside the station and its park and ride; foot and car traffic plus rail noise.
drivers.convention: Cars park here but 2P Mon-Fri 8am-5:30pm signs and a No Stopping Any Time sign apply.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign near the start
sun_shade: Trees shade part of the east side; houses block morning sun at the kerb.
